about:
Outlaw Woodworks LLC operates from Three Forks, Montana, where it was founded in 2005. The company began as a cabinetry shop focused on designing, building, and finishing custom cabinets for clients in the region.

The shop designs, manufactures, and finishes custom cabinets using computer-programmed machinery and software to achieve precision. Processes include custom cabinet design, CNC machining, finishing, and installation. Since 2005, the company has completed thousands of projects, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Outlaw Woodworks serves residential and commercial construction customers, including homeowners, builders, and contractors seeking custom cabinetry and closet solutions. Testimonials reference custom solutions for building needs and high-quality cabinets and closets.

The company emphasizes attention to detail, a commitment to not cutting corners, and exceeding customer expectations from design through delivery. Professionalism, respect for client property and time, and consistent on-time performance are cited as distinguishing factors.
